$comment: Machine-readable Kyrve brand lock. docs/brand/KYRVE-BRAND-LOCK.md is the prose form of this file; verify-assets.py enforces the hashes. Change nothing here without an owner decision recorded in the lock document.

brand.name: Kyrve
brand.wordmarkCase: lowercase in product branding; sentence-case 'Kyrve' in prose, legal text and documentation
brand.thesis: Many confidential curves. One selected executable quote.
brand.positioning: Institutional fixed-income terminal. Private price discovery, public settlement.
brand.symbol: Layered private-curve form converging into one selected cobalt leaf — the quote point.

card.role: card surface, one value step above canvas, no shadow

accent.role: the single primary action per page; never decoration

contrastOnCanvas.$comment: WCAG 2.x contrast ratio against #171721, computed by scripts/brand/verify-assets.py.

clearSpace.rule: no element within 12% of the mark's longest edge on any side
clearSpace.$comment: The shipped symbol master already carries this padding; SYMBOL_PADDING in scripts/brand/build-assets.py is the same constant.

minimumSize.$comment: Below 24px the curve layers collapse into a single stroke and the cobalt leaf stops resolving. 96px is where the descender in 'kyrve' survives hinting.

permittedLockups: symbol with the kyrve wordmark set horizontally to its right
wordmark alone, where the symbol already appears elsewhere on the same surface

backgrounds.$comment: SEE THE OPEN DECISION IN docs/brand/KYRVE-BRAND-LOCK.md. Measured on the approved master: 100% of opaque mark pixels clear 4.5:1 against white; 0.0% clear 4.5:1 against Onyx #171721, median 1.20:1. The dark presentation exists only baked into the approved OG and CTA rasters, on a near-black #01091a field rather than on Onyx.
backgrounds.darkNearBlack: approved only as it appears inside the OG and CTA rasters
backgrounds.darkOnyxCanvas: NOT approved — the master is not legible there and must not be recoloured to make it so

monochrome.rule: one-colour reproduction uses the mark's silhouette in a single ink, never a flattened greyscale of the gradient

forbidden: recolouring the mark, including to make it legible on Onyx
regenerating, redrawing or auto-tracing the mark
rotating, skewing, mirroring or non-uniformly scaling
applying shadow, glow, outline, stroke or bevel
placing the mark on a photographic or patterned background
reconstructing the wordmark in a substitute typeface
cropping the symbol, or altering the trim padding
using the symbol as a repeating pattern or watermark
upscaling any export beyond its approved source resolution

simplification.rule: the favicon is the symbol alone, trimmed and centred on a square canvas — never the wordmark, never a letterform
simplification.atOrBelow32px: the layered curves read as mass, not as separate strokes; the cobalt leaf is the only element that must stay individually identifiable
simplification.$comment: No separate simplified drawing is authored. Legibility at 16px comes from premultiplied downscaling of the approved master, verified against a composite-then-downscale reference in scripts/brand/verify-assets.py.

vector.$comment: There is no SVG master and none is claimed. The approved artwork carries soft radial glow and gradient fills whose geometry cannot be faithfully reconstructed as editable vector paths. Auto-tracing the raster edge and shipping the result as a production SVG would misstate what the file is. If a true vector master is ever required it must come from the original design source, not from these rasters.
